verdict.rationale: Restate documents a dedicated AI-agents use case and 'durable agent' pattern (ctx.run wrapping LLM calls/tools, automatic retries, state persistence) and even a coding-agent plugin, but the evidence never names first-party wrappers for specific AI SDKs, agent frameworks, or model providers (e.g., LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK) — it's generic durable-execution primitives applied to agent workloads rather than turnkey framework integrations. missing for 10: named first-party SDK/framework/provider integrations, evidence of zero-glue-code wrapping for a specific popular AI stack, independent confirmation of such integrations working.
